free_tier_limits: API is free with no published paid tier; commercial use is generally permitted under the API Terms of Use, though Discogs may restrict particular commercial uses at its discretion. Rate limited (see rate_limits).
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official Discogs API Terms of Use (https://www.discogs.com/developers#page:terms-of-use and linked terms) state commercial use is generally permitted subject to the API Terms and Discogs' discretion to prohibit particular commercial uses — not a blanket "requires approval" gate. No published paid API tier. Entry free_tier_limits overstated the commercial restriction.
